payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: complete: the image as a whole is rendered as a chalk drawing, with a coherent drawn appearance across the main subject and surrounding scene; judge the overall rendering rather than relying on grain, softened edges, or any single cue. A chalk-like texture or filter can count if it makes the image read as a drawing. partial: visible progress toward a chalk drawing, but the overall image still substantially reads as a photograph or the drawing treatment is uneven. absent: no requested change has progressed. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress or completion. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image consistently renders the giraffes and surrounding scene with soft, smudged chalk-like strokes and a drawn appearance, rather than reading as a photograph.","confidence":0.96}
